_doc: P7a contract §5.2 (slack-ingest.test.ts, Area B) and the envelope set the §5.3 V2 route tests (Area C) and the SQL suite's RQ12 (Area A) build on.
Lead-owned, frozen. Recorded Slack shapes (p7/slackdocs, ING §1.2-§2.2, PLAT §5); every message_changed / message_deleted event carries hidden: true.
Row: name; envelope (an event_callback for team T0SCALED / app A0EXEC, authorized for his user id unless the row says otherwise);
expectEventType = deriveIngestFacts(json).eventType; expectChannel = its channel (§2.5 for lifecycle);
expectPrefilter = prefilterIngest's answer; expectFacts = the IngestFacts (full for msg/edit rows, partial for delete/lifecycle: use toMatchObject);
expectDerive: null = deriveIngestFacts returns null (not a reading event; the route never calls prefilterIngest).
A row marked `unverified` uses a shape the docs don't record ([U]); §7.3 step 7 records it live.
No row puts a sentinel inside a DD URL. `channels` describes the exec_slack_channels rows the gate rows assume (seed them as needed).
candidateReasons: the IG20 table (also V220 through v2, and v2 step 15's SQL twin).
